title: Hundreds of ‘free’ academic journals have started charging fees
title_zh: 数百本原本免费的学术期刊开始收取费用
abstract: A study tracking diamond open-access journals has found an increase in titles switching to other publishing models — especially over the past few years.
abstract_zh: 一项跟踪钻石开放获取期刊的研究发现，越来越多的期刊转向其他出版模式，尤其在过去几年中。
